title: 加热回流
source_doc: course/MIT Digital Lab Techniques Manual/17_Refluxing a Reaction.md
author_source: project/MIT Digital Lab Techniques Manual/17_Refluxing a Reaction/src.py

points.K10: 搅拌和沸石怎么防暴沸
points.K25: 回流：安全地长时间加热

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一套回流装置旁，冷凝管竖在烧瓶上
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a reflux setup with a vertical condenser on a round-bottom flask in a heating mantle, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课学加热回流。

shots.scene: 蒸气上升、液滴回落的循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: A circular arrow icon: vapor rising up a condenser and drops falling back into a flask. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸上去、冷下来、流回去。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一个盖紧的瓶子要放到加热板上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a tightly capped bottle of reaction mixture over a hot plate.
shots.narration: 阿杰的反应要加热几个小时。

shots.scene: 小研拦住，比划开盖瓶蒸干的样子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and gestures at an open beaker with vapor escaping.
shots.narration: 盖紧了会炸，敞着溶剂又跑光。

shots.scene: 小研指着冷凝管
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at a condenser on the shelf.
shots.narration: 小研说：用回流装置就行。

shots.scene: 钟表图标和慢慢变化的反应瓶
shots.prompt_en: A flask of reaction mixture next to a clock icon and a small heat icon. No people.
shots.narration: 很多反应，要加热才能按时做完。

shots.scene: 盖紧的瓶子加热后鼓胀炸裂的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a sealed flask on a heater swelling and bursting, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 密闭加热，压力越积越高会爆炸。

shots.scene: 敞口烧杯里溶剂蒸发跑光
shots.prompt_en: An open beaker on a heater with solvent vapor escaping and the level dropping. No people.
shots.narration: 敞口加热，溶剂会蒸发跑掉。

shots.scene: 回流装置打勾
shots.prompt_en: A reflux setup icon with a green check mark between a crossed-out sealed flask and a crossed-out open beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 回流能在沸点长时间加热，不跑也不炸。

shots.scene: 溶液沸腾，蒸气上升进冷凝管
shots.prompt_en: The solution boils in the flask and vapor rises into the condenser. No people.
shots.narration: 把溶液加热到沸腾。

shots.scene: 冷凝管里蒸气变成液滴流回
shots.prompt_en: Inside the condenser the vapor turns into drops that run back down into the flask. No people.
shots.narration: 冷凝管不停冷却，蒸气变液体流回去。

shots.scene: 有机反应图标大多带回流标记
shots.prompt_en: A grid of reaction flask icons, about eight out of ten marked with a small reflux condenser symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 大约百分之八十的有机反应要用回流。

shots.scene: 台面摆着圆底烧瓶、冷凝管、搅拌器、润滑脂
shots.prompt_en: On a bench: a round-bottom flask on a cork ring, a condenser, a magnetic stirrer with a stir bar, and a jar of grease. No people.
shots.narration: 备好烧瓶、冷凝管、搅拌子和润滑脂。

shots.scene: 铁架台、夹子、薄壁橡胶管、管箍
shots.prompt_en: A ring stand, two extension clamps, two pieces of thin rubber tubing and three hose clamps. No people.
shots.narration: 铁架台、夹子、两根水管、三个管箍。

shots.scene: 加热套、铁圈、调压器
shots.prompt_en: A heating mantle, an iron ring and a variable voltage controller with a blank dial. No people.
shots.narration: 还有加热套、铁圈和调压器。

shots.scene: 溶剂瓶旁三个勾选框
shots.prompt_en: A solvent bottle with a blank label next to three check boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 好的回流溶剂，要满足三条。

shots.scene: 试剂全溶、不起反应两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: powders fully dissolving in a flask, and a solvent drop beside a reagent with a no-reaction symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 能溶解全部试剂，又不和它们反应。

shots.scene: 温度计指向较高刻度
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon pointing to a fairly high mark with a fast arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 沸点够高，反应才跑得快。

shots.scene: 试剂溶好倒入圆底烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand pours a dissolved reagent solution from a beaker into a round-bottom flask on a cork ring.
shots.narration: 试剂溶好，倒进圆底烧瓶。

shots.scene: 烧瓶液面不超过一半的刻线
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the flask with liquid below a halfway line. No people.
shots.narration: 装量不超过一半。

shots.scene: 过热的溶液突然冒出大气泡
shots.prompt_en: Animated diagram of a superheated liquid suddenly erupting with a huge bubble. No people.
shots.narration: 过热的溶液会突然喷出大气泡，叫暴沸。

shots.scene: 液体冲出瓶口、引燃小火的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of liquid shooting out of a flask and catching a small flame, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 会损失物料，甚至着火。

shots.scene: 搅拌子和沸石两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a stir bar and a small heap of boiling stones. No people.
shots.narration: 所以要加搅拌子或沸石。

shots.section_title: 搅拌和沸石怎么防暴沸
shots.scene: 搅拌子旋转，大气泡被打散
shots.prompt_en: A spinning stir bar creates swirling flow that breaks a large bubble into small ones. No people.
shots.narration: 搅拌造成湍流，把大气泡打散。
overlay: 搅拌和沸石怎么防暴沸

shots.section_title: 搅拌和沸石怎么防暴沸
shots.scene: 多孔沸石不断冒出细小气泡
shots.prompt_en: A porous boiling stone releasing a steady stream of tiny bubbles. No people.
shots.narration: 沸石多孔，受热冒出细小气泡。

shots.scene: 冷溶液里放沸石，勾号
shots.prompt_en: Boiling stones dropped into a cool solution before heating, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 沸石一定在加热前放进去。

shots.scene: 向热溶液里加沸石、液体喷出的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of boiling stones dropped into a hot solution with liquid shooting out, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 加到热溶液里，会瞬间沸腾冲出来。

shots.scene: 烧瓶夹在铁架台上
shots.prompt_en: The round-bottom flask is clamped to a ring stand. No people.
shots.narration: 烧瓶夹在铁架台上。

shots.scene: 冷凝管阳口薄涂一层脂，接上烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: A thin film of grease is spread on the condenser joint, which is then fitted onto the flask.
shots.narration: 冷凝管口轻涂脂，竖着接上烧瓶。

shots.scene: 进水管接下口，出水管接上口
shots.prompt_en: Arrows show the inlet hose on the lower port and the outlet hose on the upper port of the condenser. No people.
shots.narration: 进水接下口，出水接上口。

shots.scene: 水管冲脱、水淹台面的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hose popping off and water flooding the bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 管箍箍紧，免得水压一变冲脱水管。

shots.scene: 加热套和铁圈放在烧瓶下
shots.prompt_en: A heating mantle on an iron ring is raised under the flask. No people.
shots.narration: 烧瓶下放好加热套和铁圈。

shots.scene: 大加热套里填沙
shots.prompt_en: Sand is poured into the gap around a small flask in a larger heating mantle.
shots.narration: 宁大勿小，大了用沙填满。

shots.scene: 加热套插头插进调压器
shots.prompt_en: The heating mantle plug goes into the outlet on a voltage controller. No people.
shots.narration: 加热套插在调压器上。

shots.scene: 直接插墙上插座的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the heating mantle plug pushed straight into a wall socket, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不直接插墙上插座。

shots.scene: 冷凝管顶端开口，箭头指向空气
shots.prompt_en: The open top of the condenser with an arrow pointing out to the air. No people.
shots.narration: 开始前确认：冷凝管顶端敞开。

shots.scene: 冷凝管顶端塞住的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a stopper jammed into the condenser top while heating, crossed out with a big red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不能加热密闭体系！

shots.scene: 手逐个摸过管箍
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand checks each hose clamp on the condenser tubing.
shots.narration: 再查一遍管箍，打开冷凝水。

shots.scene: 调压器旋钮慢慢调高，烧瓶开始平稳沸腾
shots.prompt_en: The controller knob turns up slowly and the solution begins a gentle boil. No people.
shots.narration: 慢慢调高电压，直到平稳沸腾。

shots.scene: 溶液上方出现冷凝环
shots.prompt_en: A ring of condensing vapor forms above the boiling solution. No people.
shots.narration: 溶液上方出现一圈冷凝环。

shots.scene: 冷凝管里液滴流回烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: Drops run down the inside of the condenser back into the flask. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸气在冷凝管里变成液滴，流回烧瓶。

shots.scene: 冷凝管上三个高度标记，中间打勾
shots.prompt_en: A condenser with three level markers; the middle one has a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 调节加热，让冷凝环停在一半高。

shots.scene: 冷凝环太高，蒸气从顶端跑出
shots.prompt_en: The condensate ring at the very top with vapor escaping from the condenser opening, with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 太高，样品会从顶上跑掉。

shots.scene: 冷凝环太低，钟表转了很多圈
shots.prompt_en: The ring sitting low near the flask and a clock spinning many turns. No people.
shots.narration: 太低，反应要拖很久。

shots.scene: 降下加热套，烧瓶冷却，最后关水
shots.prompt_en: The heating mantle is lowered, the flask cools beside a clock icon, then the water tap is turned off. No people.
shots.narration: 结束：撤热源，烧瓶凉了，再关水。

shots.scene: 冷凝管顶上装一支干燥管
shots.prompt_en: A drying tube filled with white granules is fitted on top of the condenser. No people.
shots.narration: 要无水，就在顶上装干燥管。

shots.scene: 干燥管开口通气、挡住水汽的示意
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of air passing through the drying tube while water droplet icons are blocked. No people.
shots.narration: 体系还是敞开的，但水汽进不来。

shots.scene: 冷凝管顶上接三通，一头氮气一头鼓泡器
shots.prompt_en: A T-connector on the condenser top; one arm goes to a nitrogen line, the other to a small oil bubbler. No people.
shots.narration: 或接三通，一头通氮气，一头接鼓泡器。

shots.scene: 滴液漏斗、玻璃塞、克氏蒸馏头三件器材
shots.prompt_en: An addition funnel with a stopcock, a glass stopper and a two-necked bent adapter laid side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 回流中加料：滴液漏斗、玻璃塞、克氏头。

shots.scene: 克氏头装在烧瓶上，冷凝管在正上方，漏斗在侧口
shots.prompt_en: The two-necked adapter is fitted on the flask; the condenser sits on the straight neck and the funnel on the side neck. No people.
shots.narration: 冷凝管装正上方，漏斗装侧口。

shots.scene: 每个磨口涂脂
shots.prompt_en: A gloved finger greases each ground glass joint before assembly.
shots.narration: 所有磨口都要涂脂。

shots.scene: 三颈瓶装置，一口冷凝管一口漏斗一口隔垫
shots.prompt_en: A three-necked flask with a condenser in the middle neck, an addition funnel on one side and a rubber septum on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 也可以用三颈瓶，空着的口塞上隔垫。

shots.scene: 带侧管和不带侧管的两种滴液漏斗
shots.prompt_en: Two addition funnels: one with a side pressure-equalizing arm, one without. No people.
shots.narration: 漏斗没有恒压侧管？

shots.scene: 手取下漏斗顶上的玻璃塞，液体顺利滴下
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand lifts the glass stopper off the funnel and the liquid starts dripping again.
shots.narration: 滴不动时，取下塞子破除负压。

shots.section_title: 回流：安全地长时间加热
shots.scene: 欣欣拍拍回流装置竖大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pats the reflux setup and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 回流：长时间加热，不炸瓶、不跑溶剂。
overlay: 回流：安全地长时间加热

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现半满的烧瓶和搅拌子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a half-full round flask and a stir bar.
shots.narration: 装量不过半，搅拌子或沸石防暴沸。

shots.scene: 冷凝管下进上出和管箍图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a condenser with water in at the bottom and out at the top, and hose clamps. No people.
shots.narration: 下进上出，管箍箍紧。

shots.scene: 敞开的冷凝管顶和调压器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an open condenser top and a variable transformer. No people.
shots.narration: 顶端敞开，接调压器，慢慢升温。

shots.scene: 冷凝环在一半高的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a condenser with a ring of condensing vapor halfway up. No people.
shots.narration: 冷凝环一半高；撤热、冷却、再关水。

shots.scene: 干燥管、三通和滴液漏斗图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a drying tube, a three-way adapter and an addition funnel. No people.
shots.narration: 无水装干燥管，加料用滴液漏斗。

shots.scene: 欣欣在回流装置前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of a gently refluxing setup.
shots.narration: 稳稳回流，安全反应，下次见！
